submission.justification:
CONDITIONAL RECOMMENDATION. Absorber-F1 at 5 mm gave the best recorded energy resolution at 100 GeV (3.266%, versus 4.073% for F3 and 5.05% for F2 at 5 mm). Among F1 thicknesses tested, 3 mm gave 3.337%, 2 mm gave 3.742% and 10 mm gave 4.66%, so 5 mm is the best of those.

The hard dose constraint is NOT verified for any option. The dose estimate for all three materials at 2-10 mm returned -1 (no data), all three are flagged unverified, and no simulation or dose calculation was recorded as run. The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown, which must not exceed 20 uSv/h, is therefore unknown for F1, F2 and F3. F1 cannot be adopted until its dose rate is computed and shown to be at or below 20 uSv/h at 5 mm. If it exceeds the limit, the next candidate is F3 (4.073% at 5 mm), and the dose check must be repeated for it too.

Also note a provenance inconsistency: the record shows simulations_run = 0, yet resolution values are recorded. The resolution figures should be confirmed against the simulation outputs before they are relied on.
